svg.title: Reading a spine X-ray: after the ABCS sweep, each abnormality has its view, its sign and what it means next: fracture (stable or unstable), facet dislocation, pars defect and spondylolisthesis, ankylosing spondylitis and prevertebral soft-tissue swelling, with scoliosis on the pediatric orthopedics chart
